Generate application SDK source from an OpenAPI document.

Usage:
  openapi-sdkgen generate [options]

Required:
  --input <source>                OpenAPI file, file:// URL, HTTP(S) URL, or -
  --target <name>                 SDK target (available: typescript)
  --output <directory>            Fresh output directory

Generation:
  --with <addon>                  Add generated artifacts (available: server)
                                  (repeatable)

Input:
  --input-base <source>           Base location for relative references from stdin
  --http-header-env <header=env>  Read an input request header from an environment
                                  variable (repeatable)
  --tls-client-cert <path>        PEM client certificate for an HTTPS input
  --tls-client-key <path>         PEM private key for an HTTPS input
  --tls-ca-file <path>            Additional PEM certificate authorities for an HTTPS
                                  input

Remote references:
  --allow-remote-ref <origin>     Allow an exact HTTPS remote-reference origin
                                  (repeatable)
  --ref-lock <path>               Remote-reference and extension lock path
  --update-ref-lock               Create or update the integrity lock
  --offline                       Use only locked cached remote references

Schema extensions:
  --schema-extension <manifest>   Register a trusted schema-extension manifest
                                  (repeatable)

Options:
  -h, --help                      Show help

Examples:
  openapi-sdkgen generate \
    --input ./openapi.yaml \
    --target typescript \
    --output ./src/generated/api
